request.description:
`status`'s request: what the session holds, answered at once, even while another of its
commands runs. It never reads the file.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

request.title: StatusRequest

Coordinate.description: A value the solver works out, in millimetres: a number, read correctly rounded to the nearest 64-bit float, and written in full as the shortest decimal that reads back as it. Within a kilometre of the origin.

Disk.description: What a comparison of a session's file on disk found, as `status` gives it.

oneOf.description: The bytes the session last read or wrote.

Other bytes. With no transaction open, the session reloads them itself (`reload`);
inside one, its `commit` is refused as a `conflict` until it rolls back. A file this
session's own save left part written reads `changed` too, and isn't reloaded: the
next save says where its old text is.
Not a regular file this user may read, or past what Silico reads of a document.

DragOpen.description: What a drag grabbed, as the request named it.

curve.description: The curve whose edge is dragged, by its ID; null for a point.

point.description: The point dragged, by its ID; null for a curve's edge.

press.description:
Where the press on the curve's edge landed, in the sketch's coordinates; null for a
point.

sketch.description: The sketch, by its feature's ID.

ElementId.description: A sketch element's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u), unique within its sketch.

FeatureId.description: A feature's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u).

PublishedRead.description: A command that reads the published model, by name, as a tool is named: what `status` lists among its reads, and `cancel` stops.

done.description:
The rebuild's steps settled so far (built, failed, kept from before, or never to
run), all of them once it has finished: progress, a diagnostic, not a result. Null if
no rebuild of the revision has started.

revision.description: The revision it's of: the session's current one.

steps.description:
The steps in the rebuild's plan, none until it's made: progress, a diagnostic. Null
if no rebuild of the revision has started.

RebuildState.description: What's become of a revision's rebuild.

oneOf.description:
Not started: no command has needed its model yet, or the gate refused the document,
so there's nothing to rebuild.

Done, but its model holds a kernel fault, kept as the revision's outcome (reads give
it once, in the response's `model.fault`); or its recompute failed.
Cancelled: the next command that needs its model starts it again.

RunningCommand.description: What runs on a session's thread, by name: a command, as a tool is named, which `cancel` stops; or `reload`, the session's own reload of its file, found changed on disk with no transaction open, which nothing cancels.

Transaction.description: The transaction open in a session, as `status` gives it.

base.description: The revision the transaction began from: the one `rollback` returns to.

bytes.description:
What its undo stack holds, in bytes, as its bound counts it: the file's bytes as it
began, and each earlier state's texts beyond what they share.

changed.description:
Whether its document differs from the one it began from, as a commit compares them:
unsaved changes. False after undoing back to that one, or editing back to it, and a
commit then writes nothing.

dropped.description:
How many of its edits undo can no longer reach, the undo stack's bound (`version`'s
`undo_bytes`) having dropped their states: 2 at the first drop (the edits before and
after the state dropped), one more at each after. `rollback` still returns to the
state it began from.

redo.description: How many `redo` can redo: the edits undone, until an edit drops them.

undo.description: How many of its edits `undo` can undo, one step each.

result.description:
`status`'s result. What's running is a diagnostic, not a result: it depends on when it's
asked.

disk.description:
What the last comparison of the session's file on disk found, against the bytes the
session last read or wrote: a diagnostic, never a result, and it reloads nothing
itself. `status` starts the next comparison, off its caller's thread, once the last
ended a second ago or more. Null before one has ended, while the session's own save
runs, and after a save that failed until the next comparison ends.

drag.description:
The drag open (`drag_begin`): its sketch, and what it grabbed, as the request named
them; null if none is, once it has ended however it ended (`drag_end`, a new revision,
its worker's failure, a cancel of its move). A diagnostic.

features.description: How many features the document has: null if its text doesn't read as a document.

gated.description: Whether the gate took the document.

reads.description:
Each read of the published model running, in the order they started: `cancel` stops
every one of a name.

running.description:
What's running on the session's thread: a queued command, which `cancel` can stop,
or `reload`, its own reload of a file changed on disk; null if nothing is.

transaction.description:
The transaction open, its base as `begin` answered it, with its undo and redo: null
if none is.

result.title: StatusResult
